verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own developer docs (llms.txt) describe a MailerLite CLI that users install and run to manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from the terminal, so the core of the story is directly delivered. The evidence is a single one-line index entry, though. missing for 10: detailed CLI documentation (commands, auth, output formats such as JSON for agent use), evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install and use the MailerLite CLI to manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal.
